riskFlags.flag: Portable Text link annotations silently unrendered in 5 of 7 render sites: SplitContent, FaqAccordion, FeatureList, ContentColumns, ContactForm use bare <PortableText> with no components map, so the custom {linkType,href,page} link mark falls back to plain text. Only PortableText.tsx (used by Cta + InfoSection) resolves links. New CMS renderer must unify this — and current content may contain links editors believe are live.

Pricing exists in two unconnected sources: hardcoded frontend/app/data/pricingData.ts (drives all calculators) and CMS pricingPageTabs/pricingCalculator content (drives displayed tables). Price changes require a code deploy + CMS edit in lockstep.

Deep coupling to Sanity visual-editing runtime: defineLive/sanityFetch everywhere, stega encoding + stegaClean() scattered through section components, useOptimistic drag-and-drop reconciliation, dataAttr/createDataAttribute overlays, presentation tool config in two sanity.config.ts files. Replacement CMS must either reimplement live preview or these layers must be stripped from every component.
riskFlags.evidence: frontend/sanity/lib/live.ts, frontend/app/components/PageBuilder.tsx:84-106, BlockRenderer.tsx:128-133, stegaClean in 15+ section components

riskFlags.flag: Two divergent link-mark data shapes flow through one resolver: blockContent annotation = {linkType, href, page→page-only} with initialValue 'href'; blockContentTextOnly uses Sanity's DEFAULT link annotation = {href}; standalone link object = {linkType, href, page→page|service, queryString} with NO initialValue. linkResolver papers over this (utils.ts:35-37). Migration must normalize to one shape.
Live link data is dirty: stale href values coexist with page refs (espn.com, google.com leftovers) — migration must resolve by linkType and drop the losing branch.
riskFlags.evidence: dataset: service daycare tabCta, homepage hero secondaryCta, settings ctaButton

riskFlags.flag: JSON-LD bug ships asset _ref strings as image/logo URLs (e.g. 'image-1c1c...-90x75-png' instead of a CDN URL). Harmless today only because settings.logo is unset in data. Fix during migration.

Image pipeline to reproduce exactly: sanity-image srcset/auto-format at 16 distinct widths incl. crop+hotspot math; @sanity/image-url 1200x627 fit=crop OG images; lightbox 1600w with natural dimensions parsed from the asset _ref filename pattern /-(\d+)x(\d+)-/ — the _ref-encodes-dimensions trick breaks if new CMS asset IDs don't encode dimensions.

Build pipeline depends on Sanity typegen: predev/prebuild run `sanity schema extract` + `sanity typegen generate`; frontend types (sanity.types.ts, lib/types.ts ExtractPageBuilderType) are generated from GROQ query result types. New CMS needs an equivalent typegen story or hand-written types for 41 block shapes.
Orphaned `gallery` draft document in dataset from a deleted schema type — exclude from migration.
blockContent inline image member has no alt field but renderer reads value.alt — inline PT images can never have alt text as schema'd.

Sanity-specific Studio features in use that need replacement decisions: presentation tool, AI Assist plugin (aiAssist option on settings.ogImage + assist.instruction.context filtered in structure), Unsplash asset source, Vision. sanity.assist.task.status docs exist in dataset.

Dead fields to drop, not migrate: featureCards.darkMode, webcamPreview.webcamUrl, testimonials.googleReviewCount, settings.tagline, settings.yearEstablished, galleryShowcase images caption (defined, unrendered); 18 of 41 block types have zero live usage.

next/image is NOT used for Sanity content (sanity-image renders plain with srcset); next.config images.remotePatterns cdn.sanity.io is configured but effectively unused. Two public-folder images (hero-left-dog.png, hero-right-image.png, bg-line.png, new-prices.jpeg) live outside the CMS.
